title: DecisionEvent
description: A normalized decision event emitted by log-decision.sh and appended to metrics.jsonl / run events.jsonl. The base fields (ts, run, kind) are merged in by log-event.sh; this schema documents the full merged object.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of emission, merged in by log-event.sh (e.g. 2026-05-29T14:00:00Z).

run.description: Run identifier passed to log-decision.sh, merged in by log-event.sh.

kind.description: user_choice when chosen == tentative (or no tentative given); user_override when chosen != tentative. May be set explicitly by caller.

slug.description: Optional plan slug, added by log-event.sh when Z_HARNESS_SLUG is set.

question_id.description: Stable normalized id for the decision (e.g. provider_for_task, dirty_tree_strategy). Kebab-cased normalization of the question when no natural id exists.

decision_key.description: Grouping key used by axiom-extract.py (R8). Always equals question_id.

chosen.description: The option label the user picked (normalized).

options.description: JSON array of option labels offered to the user. Empty array when not provided.

tentative.description: The orchestrator's pre-pick / recommended option, or null when the orchestrator had no recommendation.

source_command.description: The slash command or script that emitted this event (e.g. z-plan, z-implement-next), or null when not provided.

event_id.description: Stable event identifier: e-<sha1(run + question_id + chosen + ts)[:8]>. Used by axiom evidence citations.
